title: Flatness of one-homogeneous one-phase Bernoulli minimizers in dimensions at most six
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of the flatness half of the main theorem of the OpenAI preprint "The critical dimension for one-phase Bernoulli minimizers" (September 24, 2026): for 1 ≤ d ≤ 6, every nonnegative, nonzero, one-homogeneous global minimizer u of the one-phase Bernoulli energy J(v; B) = ∫_B |∇v|² + 1_{v > 0} in ℝᵈ is flat, that is, u(x) = max(⟪x, e⟫, 0) for almost every x, for some unit vector e.
